effect: Two anticoagulants together greatly raise bleeding risk (only when bridging under supervision).
Two NSAIDs add stomach and kidney risk without more benefit.
Two sulfonylureas add low-blood-sugar risk without more benefit.
Two ACE inhibitors duplicate the same effect.
Two ARBs duplicate the same effect.
Two beta blockers duplicate the same effect (slow heart rate and low blood pressure).
Two statins duplicate the same effect and raise the risk of muscle side effects.
Two PPIs duplicate the same effect.
Two antibiotics of the same class duplicate the same effect.
Two antihistamines add drowsiness without more benefit.
